t: In the forecourt of Guy's Hospital in Southwark stands a statue of Thomas Guy, and it's Grade II listed. Guy was an English merchant and politician, best known for founding the hospital behind you, so it's fitting that he stands at its front. The statue is by Peter Scheemakers, a Flemish sculptor who worked in London for most of his life. His classicist public and church sculptures had an important influence on the development of modern sculpture in England.
